propositions: The completion-verifier standing eval constructs a single PydanticAIRunner before entering per-case disposable repositories, causing filesystem and ticket tools to read the checkout root instead of case fixture roots.
runner._effective_config substitutes only the request model and preserves the base repo_path, so injected live runners retain their original LLMConfig.repo_path from the checkout.
Completion cases that require fixture files (src/cli.py, app/profile.py) fail because the agent searches the eval checkout; operator-attested cases pass because they do not require fixture code.
The fix re-roots each injected PydanticAIRunner at its disposable case store and clears tickets_path so ticket tools read the fixture's seeded store rather than the checkout.

After the fix, the full 11-case completion-verifier standing eval passes all 3 epochs with coverage 1.0 and epoch_pass=[True, True, True], confirming agents read their own disposable fixture repositories.
